name: pialmeida-portfolio
description: Personal portfolio site. Static HTML/CSS/JS; this package only holds the test tooling.

scripts.lint: html-validate index.html 404.html pt/index.html vgc/index.html pt/vgc/index.html && html-validate --config tests/htmlvalidate-reports.json vgc/reports/*.html && node --check js/fluid.js && node --check js/main.js && node --check js/fourier.js && node --check js/projects.js
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
